card.name: Punctuation inside ingredient and nutrient lists
card.fires_on: Commas, semicolons and openers like "(" or "of" that sit inside lists of ingredients, vitamins, trace metals or chemical names. The next item is often a chemical or mineral name.

modes.label: List separators
modes.description: A comma or semicolon between items in a run of vitamins, trace elements or inactive ingredients.
